integrity.analytical_basis: Exact finite combinatorial census through ten total species, explicit eleven-species witness, integer union-size polynomial identities

scientific_limitations: Only connected simple bipartite networks, each pollinator of degree 3, per-labeled-plant/pair coextinction equality, iid equal-probability pollinator failures; twin pollinator neighborhoods allowed. A different minimum may apply if twins are prohibited or if other models are allowed.
title: Eleven-species threshold for third-order coextinction risk invisible to pairwise losses
